title: NOTICE No.RJ-26-2026 dated 05.11.2026 regarding suspension of practice of publishing separate Wednesday Weekly List (WWL)
text:

dated 21.06.2025

FULL TEXT:
Read:
Notice
No.
Rj/13/2025
dated 21.06.2025
NOTICE
NO.RJ/26/2026
As per the direction of the Hon'ble the Acting Chief Justice and
the Hon'ble Judges of the High Court of Gujarat, all Learned Advocates,
Litigants, Party-in-Person and stakeholders are hereby informed that
the practice of publishing a separate “Wednesday Weekly List” on
Wednesdays under the Wednesday Weekly List (WWL) notified vide
Notice
No.RJ/13/2025
dated
21.06.2025,
is
hereby
suspended,
till
further orders.
By
order
of
the Hon'ble the
Acting
Chief
Justice
Date:
05.11.2026
Registrar
(Judicial)
